findings.title: Unguarded put(std::span<temporary_buffer<char>>) override breaks build at SEASTAR_API_LEVEL 7/8
findings.claim: The override is unguarded but that member only exists under SEASTAR_API_LEVEL >= 9; below 9 the pure virtual is put(net::packet), so this causes an override-of-nothing error and leaves the class abstract, while CMakeLists.txt still lists 7 and 8 as valid levels.

findings.title: Queue-drain half of the fix is untested
findings.claim: _outgoing_queue is empty when the test reaches stream_close() because sink_impl::close() awaits the eof-marker send() before calling close_sink(), so queue_drained is already resolved and the drain is a no-op; reverting the std::exchange/then_wrapped hunk while keeping _stream_closing still leaves the new test green.

findings.title: Test never asserts send() is refused
findings.claim: The try/catch (const rpc::closed_error&) passes whether or not the frame is rejected, since only the downstream put_after_close symptom is checked; needs BOOST_REQUIRE_THROW or a BOOST_FAIL after the .get().

findings.title: Comment contradicts the code regarding who waits on _outgoing_queue_ready
findings.claim: The comment states 'Nothing else waits for _outgoing_queue_ready from here on', but stop_send_loop() does wait on it, at src/rpc/rpc.cc:225; the code itself is correct, but the comment misstates it.

findings.title: buffer_size() hardcoded to 8192 instead of forwarding to _inner
findings.claim: Every other method forwards to _inner, but buffer_size() is hardcoded to 8192; connected_socket::output() passes buffer_size = 0, so the stream under test adopts 8192 instead of the real sink's size, an unnecessary divergence from production in a reproducer.

findings.title: const_cast used to record hooks
findings.claim: A const_cast is used only because the factories are non-const locals; making hooks mutable would avoid the const_cast.

findings.title: Positional hook selection hardcodes count and order of negotiations
findings.claim: BOOST_REQUIRE_EQUAL(hooks.size(), 2u) plus hooks.back() hard-codes both the count and order of client-side negotiations, so a change to rpc_test_env setup would silently retarget the test.
